messages:
maria_pm: Ok kick-off thread for routing/fallback PRD — need a concise spec we can present to PMs + SREs by EOD Fri. Focus: tiers, regional compat, model-variant compatibility, launch gates, customer asks.
alex_eng: +1. Is the ask to cover both Hosted + Dedicated behaviors? or just Hosted for V1?
jordan_sre: we should scope Hosted + Dedicated differences. Dedicated has quota guarantees; fallback rules differ.
samir_prod: Customer asks summary: 1) predictable latency during peak, 2) deterministic fallbacks to cheaper variants, 3) audit trail of fallback decisions for compliance.
taylor_ds: Also need acceptance criteria for quality regressions when falling back -> per-prompt delta thresholds and automated evals.
maria_pm: Good. Proposed V1 scope: Hosted routing policies (tiered by customer plan), region-aware routing (prefer local models), fallback to compatible quantized variants only. Exclude private deployment for now.
ajex_typo: alex_eng: typo — s/all customers/paid customers for tiering?
alex_eng: yes, we'll apply tiering to paid and enterprise; free tier gets best-effort routing.
jordan_sre: SLOs: Target p95 latency<=250ms for small models, p95<=500ms for large. Fallback must not increase percent of 5xx errors.
samir_prod: Acceptance criteria: - Canary run @5% of traffic for 48h with no regressions; - quality delta <=2% on core prompts; - cost uplift <=15% from baseline during canary.
taylor_ds: Define quality delta: use evalset of 200 prompts per workload; metric: ROUGE-L or LLM-specific score and embed-similarity; threshold configurable per-customer.
maria_pm: Edge cases to call out: - model variant incompatible due to tokenizer mismatch -> no fallback; - region has no compatible variant -> route to remote region with latency tag and opt-in by customer.
jordan_sre: For cross-region routing add circuit-breaker: if cross-region p50 latency >2x local for 5m -> stop routing and surface incident.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: routing-service v1.3 -> 10% -> 1743220000
alex_eng: Implementation notes: routing decision tree will use priority: capacity -> region affinity -> customer tier -> cost; fallback chain is explicit list of variant IDs.
samir_prod: Need audit log schema in PRD: request_id, original_model, selected_model, reason_code, latency_ms, cost_estimate. Must be queryable in Console within 24h.
taylor_ds: Also include a small automated test harness that simulates prefix cache warm/unwarm states to ensure fallback doesn't incorrectly evict caches.
maria_pm: Launch gates checklist draft: 1) Spec approved by Eng/PM/SRE; 2) Canary pass metrics; 3) Console UI for fallback visibility; 4) Docs + runbook published; 5) Regression alerting set.
jordan_sre: Runbook: steps to force a fallback, how to revert routing policy, how to throttle canary traffic. Add commands: `curl -XPOST /admin/routing/override -d '{"customer":"C123","model":"gpt4-redwood-quant"}'`
alex_eng: Back-compat: ensure older client SDKs that pin model names still work. If model name not found -> return 412 with guidance to upgrade.
samir_prod: Customer-facing messaging: email template for when we proactively enable fallbacks during incidents. Provide opt-out instructions.
taylor_ds: Metrics to monitor: fallback_rate by customer, quality_score_delta, cross-region_routing_rate, p95 latency pre/post fallback, cost_per_1000_tokens.
ops-bot: incident-bot: Alert rule created: fallback_rate >5% sustained for 10m -> paged to oncall
maria_pm: Final asks for PRD: assign owners: Spec owner = maria_pm, Eng owner = alex_eng, SRE owner = jordan_sre, DS owner = taylor_ds, Product ops = samir_prod. I'll draft PRD and share for review tomorrow AM.
alex_eng: I'll prototype variant-compatibility matrix script and post sample CSV here.
samir_prod: Add a short section in PRD: rollback criteria (e.g., quality delta >3% or error rate spike >2x baseline).
jordan_sre: Edge-case note: API clients using long-poll streaming — ensure fallback gracefully closes stream with final token and reconnect guidance.
maria_pm: Thanks team. If no objections I'll lock scope by EOD and spin PRD. :thumbsup:
